menus.note:
Note : The first episode was premiered in TYPE-MOON's Fate Project on December 31st of 2024, one year prior to the full TV broadcast (since it got delayed); meaning that the production had not completely settled yet, leading to credits differing completely between Crunchyroll's master (hereafter CR master) and the TV broadcast.

Reviewed with BD : Overview (not episode-specific credits), OP, ED, #01 (with CR and double checked errors with TV), #02.
